Question ID: MAR_U01_L06_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.SCI.03

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Models, Inferences, and Ocean Decisions
Stimulus: Image/model/decision stimulus

A student reviews the assigned marine evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the marine science question being asked. Then use the required stimulus (Image/model/decision stimulus) to connect the visible evidence to Distinguish observations, inferences, theories, models, and decisions.. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.MAR.SCI.03 and avoids this common mistake: answering from ocean-related background knowledge instead of using the assigned marine evidence.
